notes: The transport / balloon module. The spreadsheet's unnamed 'Free Port' rows and its Components entry refer to this, but the module itself is specified in the printed art and the rulebook, not in the sheet.
One Port (Aerodrome) card per player, printed as identical copies on the Vegetable front sheet. They are NOT shuffled into the Vegetable deck, so they are absent from cards.json.

The Aerodrome is the freight delivery destination that several Vegetable cards reference. Unlike an island slot, a balloon is MOVED rather than claimed, so it can be collected repeatedly. It is deliberately unrationed.
Moving a balloon IS the Deliver action, not a free action and not a card-only effect.
moveCost is the printed 'two crates, not equal' icon: two barn cards of two DIFFERENT suits.

handMoveCost is the ALTERNATIVE payment printed on Vegetable's Depots (V4 and V8, the rebuild of 2026-08-09): discard this many cards from your HAND instead. The base rule above is unchanged for everybody, including a Vegetable seat taking the plain Deliver action; nothing else in the game may use the hand route. No suit constraint: the differing-crops rule belongs to the barn payment, and is what makes the balloon the table's sink for odd cards. This is the suit's first dial - its central risk is the hand starving, because activation costs, sowing, consignment, the visit AND 2 cards per flight all come out of a hand of 5.

Setup: all four balloons start unowned beside the play area (the centre) - no per-seat parking and no draft (ticket 06 ruling J). The reference implementation and rulebook v1 park one per seat instead; ruling J explicitly supersedes that, and the divergence is flagged to the rulings audit (ticket 07). No reward is collected at setup - rewards pay only on arrival by a move.
Legal source for a move is a NEIGHBOUR's Port or the unowned central Aerodrome. Never your own Port.

A balloon move is a Deliver but is NOT a 'Deliver to the island'. Cards gate themselves by printed phrase, which is why the ability dispatcher needs both onDeliver and onDeliverIsland trigger keys. A card printing the gated form cannot re-trigger itself off a balloon move, so no recursion guard is needed.
